extras.verified_at_basis: the seed research pass, which ended 2026-10-21; this record was not re-checked against the live service
extras.quota_verbatim: 20 GB free at signup, plus stacking achievements of 5 GB each (desktop app, mobile app, per invite, VPN trial, Pass trial) valid 365 days
extras.limits_verbatim: Transfer quota is per-IP over 6 h on free accounts — this is the real blocker for 500 GB-1 TiB/day serving, because one IP's allowance throttles before the volume is reached. Achievements expire after 365 days. Zero-knowledge encryption means every client re-encrypts.
extras.egress_verbatim: Not metered per GB, but free/non-account downloads are throttled by a transfer quota computed on your IP over the past six hours. Paid users are metered per account instead and can grant a slice of their quota to link downloaders (25% default).
extras.chaining_verbatim: 20 GB + N x 5 GB achievements per account, x unlimited free accounts. Achievement bonuses are per-account and do NOT compound within one account beyond one of each, so the multiplication is accounts, not achievements.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Native rclone backend 'mega' (Tier 2, v1.41+); official MEGAcmd CLI; MEGA S4 (S3-compatible) is the paid object store.
extras.agent_focus: Western consumer drives: Dropbox, Box, pCloud, Icedrive, Internxt, Filen, Proton Drive, MEGA, Koofr, Jottacloud, Sync.com, Tresorit, OpenDrive, Zoho, Degoo, 4shared, MediaFire

binding_note: a clock, not a quota: bytes leave whether or not transfer is completed
